# nico_ssh_key_group (Resource)

SSH Key Groups allow grouping several SSH Keys together so they can be synced to Sites and used to access the Serial Console of Instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_ssh_key_group" "example" {
  name                           = "name-value"
  version                        = "version-value"
  description                    = "description-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the SSHKeyGroup
- `version` (String) Version of the SSH Key Group being modified must be provided

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the SSHKeyGroup
- `site_ids` (List of String) List of Site objects
- `ssh_key_group_id` (String) Path parameter: ssh_key_group_id.
- `ssh_key_ids` (List of String) List of SSHKeyID objects

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date/time when the SSH key was created
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `org` (String) Organization this SSH Key Group belongs to
- `site_associations` (Attributes List) Sites the SSH Key Group is synced to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site_associations))
- `ssh_keys` (Attributes List) SSH Keys associated with this SSH Key Group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_keys))
- `status` (String) Status of the SSH Key Group
- `status_history` (Attributes List) History of the SSH Key Group states (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Tenane the SSH Key Group belongs to
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the SSH key was last updated
